# Mantisy

> Mantisy is a digital studio in Russey Keo, Phnom Penh, Cambodia. We design and build mobile apps, websites, POS systems, brand identities and document management systems for Cambodian businesses. Founded 2018.

## Services

- [UX/UI Design](https://mantisy.com/services/ux): Research, flows and interface design grounded in how your team and customers actually work.
- [Mobile Development](https://mantisy.com/services/mobile): iOS and Android apps, built and shipped to the stores.
- [Web Development](https://mantisy.com/services/web): Websites and web applications, from marketing sites to internal tools.
- [Brand Identity](https://mantisy.com/services/brand): Marks, type, colour and the rules that keep them consistent.
- [POS Systems](https://mantisy.com/services/pos): Point of sale for restaurants and retail, including stock and reporting.
- [Document Management](https://mantisy.com/services/docs): Approvals, records and filing moved off paper and out of shared drives.

## Work

- [AEON Online](https://mantisy.com/work/aeon-online): Marketplace platform — product catalogue, merchant onboarding and delivery routing.
